sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 155)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American and international networks, Gertrude Warner in *Peg o' My Heart* on *Brownstone Theater*, Keith Eden in the terrifying conclusion of *Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde* on Australia's *The Witch's Tale*, Jack Moyles in the Middle Eastern intrigue of *A Man Named Jordan*, Morton Downey on *The Coke Club*, Sons of the Pioneers on *Stars on Parade*, and Rudy Vallee with comic Lou Holtz for Royal Gelatin (1937–1955):
